title: Journalist
summary: For reporters and editors: your beat up front, your best work as a list, and a safe way for sources to reach you.

notFor: Opinion columnists with no reporting to list (start from creator)

cards.purpose: Beat, outlets, languages and corrections policy. The first thing an editor or source reads.
Three to six stories they are proudest of, newest first.
How sources reach them. The secure channel comes first.

slots.ask: What name do you publish under?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a square photo or logo for your profile picture?
slots.write: The member uploads it in the editor; never fetch one from the web.

slots.ask: Which outlets do you work for, what is your beat, and which languages do you report in?
slots.write: Two short paragraphs and a short list, as in the sample. Plain facts in the first person; no superlatives.

slots.ask: Share links to three to six stories you are proudest of.
slots.write: Per story: tag = outlet · year; title = the published headline; description = one line on what it found. Newest first. Use only links they give you.

slots.ask: Do you have a secure way for sources to reach you, such as SecureDrop or a Signal contact page?
slots.write: Their URL only. If they have none, remove the button and drop the SecureDrop sentence from the text.

slots.ask: Is there an email address you want to publish for tips? It will be visible to everyone.
slots.write: Only an address they confirm they want public.

slots.ask: Where else can people follow your work (Bluesky, a newsletter, LinkedIn)?
slots.write: The URL only for accounts; the app shows the site and account name itself. A label and one-line description only for your own pages.

slots.ask: Any talks, panels or podcast appearances you want to list?
slots.write: tag = format · year; title = the talk or episode title; description = event and city.
